generated_output.summary: In distributed non-sandbox deployments using shared disk mounts, multiple concurrent user requests accessing the same workspace path experience file race conditions and `NoSuchFileException` errors due to a global, shared `.skills-cache` directory.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: In `ReActAgent` and associated dynamic skill middleware components, the working directory and `.skills-cache` are resolved to a common shared path on the mounted disk. When concurrent requests execute `stage()` and trigger `garbageCollectOrphans`, one request deletes files out from underneath another concurrent request's `Files.walk` traversal.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect RuntimeContext and ReActAgent workspace resolution
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine agentscope-core/src/main/java/io/agentscope/core/agent/RuntimeContext.java and agentscope-core/src/main/java/io/agentscope/core/ReActAgent.java to understand how workspace paths and the global .skills-cache directory are currently resolved and shared across concurrent requests.

step_by_step_plan.title: Incorporate session or user identifiers into skill cache paths
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify workspace and skill cache path resolution logic in RuntimeContext or ReActAgent to namespace the .skills-cache directory per user or session identifier, preventing concurrent file race conditions on shared storage.

step_by_step_plan.title: Safeguard file cleanup and traversal operations
step_by_step_plan.description: Review garbageCollectOrphans and deleteRecursively usages to handle NoSuchFileException robustly during concurrent file traversals in shared disk mount environments.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add concurrency regression test and execute verification
step_by_step_plan.description: Implement a multi-threaded regression test simulating concurrent user requests accessing workspace skill staging to ensure no NoSuchFileException is thrown, then execute the test suite.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: A concurrency bug where two or more threads or processes try to read, modify, or delete the same file or directory at the same time.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Unsynchronized file operations on shared storage lead to unpredictable failures like missing files when one thread deletes an item being traversed by another.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Concurrent user requests attempt to garbage-collect and materialize skills in a shared `.skills-cache` directory, causing a race condition and `NoSuchFileException`.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Isolating shared resources by appending unique identifiers (such as user IDs or session IDs) to resource paths or keys.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Prevents data collision and interference between different tenants or users sharing the same physical storage infrastructure.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Isolating the skill cache path per user (using `userId`) prevents separate user requests from competing over the exact same `.skills-cache` directory.

common_pitfalls: Assuming single-user execution environments when dealing with file paths and temporary directories.
Performing recursive file deletions on shared directories without proper locking or per-user namespaced isolation.
